The '''''Colders Watch''''' was a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Beezrul Granf]], and the crew included [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] [[Chessa Dohhenty]] and [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] [[Dirk Harkness]].
